spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (PLAYING: capture failed -> push StreamEnded(501, retryable=true))
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §4.4 (StreamEnded carries code + detail, no Status)
description: Capture fails mid-stream: the Server pushes StreamEnded(501) — state PLAYING -> READY; diagnostics counters survive for finalization.
preconditions: State PLAYING with stream instance 1, config_generation 1.
StreamEnded carries the registry code in its own code field — the retryable=true note in §5.2 is the §6.2 registry property, not a wire field of StreamEnded.
assertions: Unsolicited push (StreamEnded has no request_id field at all — spec §4.4).
State moves PLAYING -> READY; the Client finalizes per-instance statistics (spec §5.3).
Contrast control.error-502-stream-ended-capture-end (normal end, same message shape, code 502).
A capture RESTART would push StreamEnded(502) followed by StreamStarted(new instance) — see media/instance-change for that pairing.
